heads.t: FOCUS全球新聞／歷時8年！華為遭美裁定 銀行詐欺.竊取商業機密等10罪名成立 8年前曾引發加拿大與中國關係惡化的「華為孟晚舟」案件，雖然孟晚舟經歷3年的法院監視居住後，簽下聲明承認華為曾在伊朗從事非法業務，從而返回中國，但整起案件並沒有因此落幕。美國法院陪審團近期歷經兩個月的審理，認定中國華為公司在涉及伊朗業務上詐騙銀行、違反制裁規定，以及共謀竊取商業機密等10項罪名成立，至於罰款等量刑判決將在明年9月宣布。另一方面，美國CNN首度披露，中方利用求職網站，試圖誘騙涉及國防或外交的前任與現任官員、分析師與顧問甚至是記者洩密。 31 分鐘前｜國際 FOCUS全球新聞／歷時8年！華為遭美裁定…
heads.en: FOCUS Global News/During 8 years! China has been judged by the United States for bank fraud, theft of business. Secrets and so forth. After three years in a court of law to monitor residence, China's relations in the "Wawa Meng Night Boat" case, which worsened, signed a declaration admitting that it had been working illegally in Iran and had returned to China, but the whole case did not end. After two months of trial by a jury in a US court of law, China was found guilty on 10 counts of fraud against banks, violation of sanctions and conspiracy to steal business secrets in relation to Iranian business. On the other hand, CNN has for the first time revealed that China is using its job-seeking website to try to seduce former and current officials, analysts and consultants, and even journalists involved in national defence or diplomacy. 31 minutes ago, FOCUS Global News/During 8 years!

heads.t: FOCUS全球新聞／JR逾3成路線運量低迷 地方鐵道續存危機 日本重度少子化再引爆地方交通危機！根據國土交通省統計，六家JR鐵道公司運輸密度低於2000人的路段比例超過30%，顯示地方路線面臨嚴峻的經營挑戰；部分區間更在天災衝擊下提前退場。有鑑於鐵路業者已無法獨自解決困境，日本政府首次啟動協商機制，研議路線存續與交通轉型，也有業者嘗試結合觀光、開發新商機，為地方鐵道尋找新的出路。 31 分鐘前｜國際 FOCUS全球新聞／JR逾3成路線運量低迷 地方鐵道續存危機 31 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: FOCUS Global News/JR's more than three-quarters of the route is down, local railways are in a continuing crisis, and Japan's traffic crisis is being triggered by a severe reduction in the number of children and local traffic. According to statistics from the Ministry of National Communications, six JR railway companies have a transport density of less than 30 per cent of 2,000 people, indicating a serious business challenge; some regions have been pre-empted by natural disasters. For the first time, the Japanese government has set in motion a system of negotiations to explore the sustainability of roads and traffic transformations, and some have tried to combine tourism, develop new businesses and find new ways for local railways. 31 minutes ago, the international FOCUS Global News/JR's more than three-quarters of the route was down, local railways continued to be in danger, 31 minutes ago, international.

heads.t: FOCUS全球新聞／神舟24號 首中.外籍太空人一同出任務 一帶一路倡議 中國大陸神舟二十四號載人太空船，周三（25日）載著3名太空人升空，特別的是，其中2人是中國籍，另一人是巴基斯坦籍。這是中國航太史上，第一次由中國籍和外籍太空人一起執行聯合飛行任務，也是中國的天宮太空站，第一次出現外籍太空人，而這也是第一次有巴基斯坦人進入地球軌道。這項任務，是北京「一帶一路」倡議中雙邊合作的一部分，同時，凸顯正值美國NASA國際太空站即將在2030年退役，中國要替補上位的野心。 31 分鐘前｜國際 FOCUS全球新聞／神舟24號 首中.外籍太空人一同出任務 一帶一路倡議 31 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: FOCUS Global News/Shinzhou 24. Foreign astronauts are on the move along the way to launch a human spaceship, the Chinese Land Canoe 24, with three astronauts on Wednesday (25 days), in particular, two Chinese and one Pakistani. This is the first time in Chinese history that a Chinese and a foreign spaceman have been on a joint flight mission, and the first time that a foreign spaceman has appeared at the Chinese Sky Palace Space Station, and this is the first time that Pakistanis have entered Earth orbit. This mission is part of a bipartite cooperation initiative in Beijing, which at the same time highlights China’s ambition to replace the US NASA International Space Station, which is about to retire in 2030. 31 minutes ago, FOCUS Global News/Shink 24, headline.
